evaluation: paired embedding comparison on the expanded Vinamilk corpus; document-level retrieval, sampled corpus

protocol.sample_strategy: evenly spaced chunks per document; all available chunks retained when a document has fewer than eight

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B.observation: The first of 22 embedding batches required 200.43 seconds on CPU; the run was stopped before producing scores or an artifact.

limitations: Only BGE-M3 and e5-large-v2 completed on this host. The nine queries have document labels only; 173 of 4,750 ready chunks were sampled, so results are diagnostic, not full-corpus model selection. Qwen3-Embedding requires a faster or GPU host for this protocol.
